title: Emergency Communication
description: Emergency communication involves staying informed and connected during disasters when regular communication systems may be disrupted. Having a communication plan is essential for family safety.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Emergency communication refers to the methods and plans used to stay informed and maintain contact with family, authorities, and emergency services during disasters. During emergencies, phone networks may become overloaded, power may be lost, and internet services may be disrupted. Having a robust communication plan ensures you can receive important information and stay connected with loved ones. In India, where mobile phone penetration is high but infrastructure can be vulnerable, understanding emergency communication options is crucial for personal and family safety.

sections.heading: Communication Plan
sections.content: Create a family communication plan that includes important contact numbers for all family members, emergency services, medical providers, and schools. Designate an out-of-area contact person who can coordinate information among separated family members. Ensure all family members memorize important phone numbers or carry them in writing. Discuss how and when to communicate during different emergency scenarios. Establish check-in procedures and time intervals. Include communication methods for when phone networks are down. Keep copies of the communication plan in multiple locations including emergency kits.

sections.heading: Receiving Emergency Information
sections.content: Identify reliable sources for emergency information such as All India Radio, Doordarshan, and official government social media accounts. Subscribe to emergency alert systems if available in your area. Keep a battery-powered or hand-crank radio in your emergency kit. Know the emergency broadcast frequencies for your region. Follow official weather forecasts and disaster warnings. Be aware of community alert systems such as sirens or loudspeakers. Download emergency apps from official sources. Stay informed about local hazards and emergency procedures before disasters occur.

sections.heading: Communication Methods
sections.content: Text messages often work when voice calls fail during network congestion. Use SMS for critical communications when possible. Social media platforms can be used to mark yourself safe and communicate with others. Email may work when other methods are down. Satellite phones provide communication when terrestrial networks are disrupted. Two-way radios can work for short-range communication. Ham radio operators can provide emergency communication when other systems fail. Landline phones may work when mobile networks are down. Always have multiple communication options available.

sections.heading: Power and Charging
sections.content: Keep mobile phones and other communication devices charged at all times during emergency warnings. Have backup power sources such as power banks fully charged. Consider solar chargers or hand-crank chargers for extended power outages. Keep car chargers available for mobile devices. Conserve battery life by reducing screen brightness and closing unnecessary apps. Turn off location services when not needed. Use airplane mode to save battery when not actively communicating. Keep spare batteries for devices that use replaceable batteries. Have a traditional wired phone as backup if you have a landline.

sections.heading: Communication Safety
sections.content: Do not spread unverified information or rumors during emergencies. Only share information from official sources. Be aware that scammers may attempt to exploit emergency situations. Do not share sensitive personal information on public platforms during crises. Use privacy settings appropriately on social media. Be cautious of fraudulent emergency calls or messages. Report suspicious communication to authorities. Keep emergency communication brief and focused on essential information. Respect that emergency services may be overwhelmed—only call when absolutely necessary.
